name: Resource Links
description: A compact link collection for docs, examples, templates, and external references.

accessibility.semantics: Use native semantic elements in templates before ARIA.
accessibility.keyboard: Interactive descendants must be reachable by keyboard and expose visible focus.
notes: Color is never the only communication channel.
Motion must respect prefers-reduced-motion where animation exists.

responsive.strategy: Intrinsic layout with logical properties, responsive grids, and container queries where useful.

examples.name: Standalone
examples.notes: Consumer-authored reference, no automatic prop binding. Prefix IDs before repeating.

binding.html: authored child markup in canonical example; arrays are consumer data, never automatically bound

items.contract: Authored data structure: label is displayed text; content is escaped text or trusted authored slot markup. Optional href is a consumer-owned safe navigation URL. No automatic renderer.

grid.notes: Compatible legacy name for the base appearance; no distinct attribute behavior.

stack.notes: Compatible legacy name for the base appearance; no distinct attribute behavior.

annotated.notes: Compatible legacy name for the base appearance; no distinct attribute behavior.

guidance.use: Group descriptive resource links in an intrinsic grid.
guidance.avoid: An automatic link crawler or search index.

heading.content: Trusted authored semantic HTML; preserve child structure in example.html. Text data must be escaped.

links.content: Trusted authored semantic HTML; preserve child structure in example.html. Text data must be escaped.
